metadata.source_package_note: Pass-one dispatch packet used as controlling taxonomy source; supplemental F files were cross-checked, and null or misaligned reports were preserved only as warnings.

normalization.version_policy: Distinct source versions, covers, remakes, collaborations, cast recordings, and soundtrack/score objects are preserved as separate recording objects; ambiguous risks are flagged in warnings.
